name: browser
description: Browse and act on any website with nothing connected; where it must be you, persistent human-authenticated sessions you log into once by hand (several accounts per site). Paying stops for your approval by default; posting, sending and deleting go ahead and are logged for you; set careful and all four wait for your yes. Email codes, 2-step prompts and robot checks the agent clears itself; it asks you only when stuck, or where you turned a stop on (gate).

verbs.name: browser
verbs.summary: log into a site once, then let adapters operate it

setup.hint: browser needs Google Chrome, a virtual screen, VNC and Node.js 22 on this box, which 5dive will not install behind your back. The command below installs whichever of them are missing, one named step at a time (apt boxes: Debian, Ubuntu), and after it every agent you hire gets a browser.
